thread:
Tess (AE): HarborPay wants a short POC to validate migration from CompetitorX. Requirements: top-50 prompts parity, token-billing reconciliation, and BYOK/KMS for card data. Can we do a 72h turnaround? :hourglass:
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll own the POC. Quick clarifying q: do they require byte-for-byte identical responses or 'no visible regressions' to end users?
Tess (AE): Legal said 'no visible regressions' for the top-50. They want a report showing diffs and mitigation steps for any mismatches.
Jun (SRE): Ops note: CompetitorX streams in small chunks; that affects render timing. Options: emulate chunking in our stream layer, or put a client-side re-chunker shim in the demo. Re-chunker is faster for POC. Also need expected QPS.
Tess (AE): They expect ~4-6 QPS peak, p95 <120ms. Billing sensitivity during bursts is a concern.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Plan: 1) Prompt-normalizer + compatibility shim, 2) side-by-side runs against CompetitorX and Redwood, 3) similarity scoring + token-count CSV, 4) try deterministic seeds for top-50 to reduce variance. I'll produce a runbook and sample diffs.
Elena (Security): Security asks: BYOK in their cloud, envelope encryption before leaving VPC, and 7-day auto-delete of POC logs. We'll provide SOC2 summary and a KMS checklist. For Private POC, we can disable our control plane and demonstrate BYOK.
Jun (SRE): I'll provision a small dedicated node and turn off aggressive batching to meet p95. I'll also export per-request token usage to CSV for finance reconciliation.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Potential blocker: CompetitorX uses a proprietary reranker that rewrites outputs. If their top-50 rely on that, parity may require an adapter or re-implementation. I'll enumerate this in the risk section.
Tess (AE): Add that risk to the slide deck and flag potential extra effort. Also they'll want surge caps — can we demo rate-limits and quota mapping?
Jun (SRE): Yes, I'll include an example rate-limit policy and a soft cap script.
Elena (Security): Action: I will draft KMS/crypto answers and attach audit log examples. Also confirm incident escalation contacts.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: dedicated-poc-harborpay-small  ETA 18m
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Action items: harness + normalizer (Ravi), dedicated node + token exporter (Jun), security docs + runbook (Elena), NDA + top-50 CSV from the customer (Tess). I'll post the first smoke diff in ~3h.
Tess (AE): Standup 11:00 PT tomorrow. I'll chase NDA now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
